scientific_integrity: The spectral-law theorem and all quantifiers are proved in RESULT.md. Prior generic quantum-constraint counts and the Kac mean theorem are credited as known; bibliography does not imply independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for tracial bilateral qubit shifts, identical rank-one two-site constraints, and projection-lattice return; not a repeated-measurement detection law. Finite checks are supplementary, and earlier equivalent formulations remain possible.
title: A two-law quantum Kac return spectrum for every rank-one qubit-bond projection
